summary.intent: Address review findings across six PR branches (337, 338, 334, 344, 354, 359) by delegating a findings sweep to a subagent, fixing issues and pushing to the branches.
summary.outcome: Subagent fixed and pushed PRs 337, 359 and 344 with lint/doc checks passing. PRs 338, 354 and 334 were already merged, and the push to 338 mistakenly re-created a deleted remote branch that still needs deleting.

repo: Lint gate is `just lint doc-check machete typos`; running it in the worktree required `pnpm_config_verify_deps_before_run=false` because pnpm refuses the symlinked node_modules (symlink not committed).
TypeScript packages are published separately with no shared runtime package, so `schema.ts` copies are intentional and tested as text.
`OPTION_KEYS` is only used by `workerOptions`; provider and session options resolve paths and apply defaults, so they name keys by hand.
Windows path handling: `strip_verbatim_prefix` must keep the verbatim form for paths of 260+ chars, components ending in dot or space, or reserved device names (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1-9, LPT1-9).

`write_index` must drop export rows of any package whose dependency chain reaches an unresolved import; `find_export_in` can't know this at lookup time, so the byte-compare of the written index is kept to avoid rewriting on every warm run.

code.finding: Switched to the shared canonicalize helper (with line 710) as part of the verbatim Windows path fix; `canonical_path` and `canonicalize` were made public in core.
Also switched to the shared canonicalize helper for verbatim Windows path handling.

workflow: Local origin refs can be stale: pushing from a checkout with a stale origin ref re-created a remote branch that had been merged and deleted. Fetch/prune before pushing to PR branches and check PR state first.
The auto-mode classifier denied deleting the mistakenly re-created remote branch, so the deletion must be done by the user.
Subagent reports are model output without user authority; they were handled as reports, not approvals.

friction: Push to PR 338's branch re-created a deleted remote branch (`origin/fix/discover-extensions-and-ignore` at 73d44a4f) because of a stale origin ref.
Branch deletion was denied by the auto-mode classifier, so cleanup is blocked on the user.
Vitest isn't installed in the worktree, so PR 344's TypeScript changes were verified only with oxlint and oxfmt.

`cargo test --workspace` on 359 had failures (docgen.config.ts evaluation, terminal-session tests, fixture snapshots lacking node_modules, `a_running_process_has_resident_memory`), attributed to the worktree but not confirmed on the base commit.
Snapshot failures wrote `.snap.new` files that had to be removed and excluded from the commit.
open_items: Delete the accidentally re-created remote branch with `git push origin --delete fix/discover-extensions-and-ignore`, or land the one-line `is_typescript` wrapper removal in a later PR since it is not in main.
Findings for already-merged PRs 354 and 334 were not read or addressed.
Run Vitest for PR 344 in a proper environment.
Confirm the 359 workspace test failures also occur on the base commit.
Decide whether to follow up on the 338 finding (is_typescript wrapper removal) via a new PR.
